subject: Post-demo model follow-up — version delta & next steps
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Tran <sofia.tran@quantile.ai>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-14T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-demo model follow-up — version delta & next steps

Hi Sofia —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum: 

What we covered
- Demo: intent + entity extraction flow on your loan-approval dataset
- Recommended models for initial pilot: rw-instruct-13b-q2 (balanced latency/cost) and rw-chat-7b-qat (for chat UX)
- Key quality metrics to watch: slot F1, hallucination rate on denial reasons, and average latency at 512 tokens

Deliverables I attached/linked
- Evaluation pack (Drive): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1QntEvalPack
- Redwood eval report (preview): https://redwood-inference.app/reports/QNTL-4712/eval-pack
- Prompt set we used in demo: attached as qa_prompt_set_v1.txt

Immediate asks / next steps
1) Please confirm which model you want pinned for the 2-week pilot (suggest rw-instruct-13b-q2).
2) Grant us permission to run the side-by-side audit on your staging workspace (low-risk read-only requests) — link/credentials instructions in the eval pack.
3) Can we schedule a 30-min technical triage on Tue or Wed to review the baseline prompts and error cases?

If you prefer, we can also lock the workspace to a fixed model hash while we run the eval; that avoids surprise version drift during the pilot.

Thanks — I’ll loop Aditya and Marissa who will own the technical audit and eval pack distribution.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-2193

Attachments: qa_prompt_set_v1.txt (text), eval-pack-drive-link (link)

From: Sofia Tran <sofia.tran@quantile.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Quantile.ai - ML Platform Team <ml-platform@quantile.ai>
Date: 2027-03-15T09:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo model follow-up — version delta & next steps

Hi Lauren & team —

Appreciate the clear recap and the materials. Two quick things from our side: 

1) We ran a quick smoke check this morning and observed a noticeable drop in entity extraction recall on our denial-reason examples starting around 2027-03-14 02:00 UTC. Our infra team noted the model hash changed in the managed endpoint (appears to be an automatic candidate roll from rw-instruct-13b-v2 -> v3).

2) I attached a small sample of our logs (quantile_logs_0316.zip) and a short CSV of failed cases for your triage. We are worried this will skew pilot metrics if left unchecked.

We are comfortable pinning a prior hash for the pilot if that’s the recommendation — want to avoid the experiment affecting internal stakeholders.

Can Aditya or Marissa advise on how quickly we could pin back to v2 in a sandbox?

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Tran
Head of ML Platform | Quantile.ai
sofia.tran@quantile.ai

> 
> Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we keep momentum: ...

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Tran <sofia.tran@quantile.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-15T11:37:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo model follow-up — version delta & next steps

Thanks Sofia — useful signal, and thanks for the logs. Quick technical read and proposed plan: 

Findings (prelim) - The sample you sent highlights a small regression in span detection where the v3 candidate tightens some tokenization boundaries; this reduced recall on ~6% of your denial samples in our quick run.

Proposed short plan (low-risk)
1) Pin current staging/trial workspace to known-good hash rw-instruct-13b-v2 for the duration of the pilot. This is a config change we can apply to your staging tenant; it is reversible and does not affect production until you flip the flag. ETA: ~4 hours once we have permission.
2) Run a side-by-side eval (we’ll push quantile_eval_v2_vs_v3_diff.pdf) against your secret test set and our prompt set (qa_prompt_set_v1.txt). Deliverable: tokenized diff + case-level annotations. ETA: 24 hours after we start.
3) If the diff shows statistically significant regression on slot F1 (>2.5 points), we keep v2 pinned for pilot and escalate to the runtime/ops team for a deeper kernel-level investigation.

Commands (for transparency)
- To pin: PATCH /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/config {"model_hash":"rw-instruct-13b-v2"}
- To snapshot: GET /api/v1/workspaces/{workspace_id}/snapshot

I attached the initial diff report and the prompt set we used in the demo for reproducibility.

If you give a quick OK I’ll coordinate with Rishi to schedule the change window and with Marissa to ship the full eval pack. We’ll keep the audit logs and a rollback path visible in the console.

Cheers,
Aditya Rao
Staff Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.ai

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Tran <sofia.tran@quantile.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-03-16T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-demo model follow-up — version delta & next steps

Sofia — thanks for the quick turnaround and Aditya for the clear playbook. Confirming next steps and owners so nothing slips: 

- Sofia / Quantile: please reply with explicit approval to pin the staging workspace to rw-instruct-13b-v2. That gives us the legal go-ahead to proceed.
- Aditya: execute the pin on staging and run the side-by-side eval; share the full PDF diff and case-level annotations. (Owner: Aditya; ETA: 24 hours after approval)
- Marissa: publish the eval pack to the Drive link and notify Quantile stakeholders; include QA prompt set and a short how-to for their SREs. (Owner: Marissa; ETA: EOD)
- Rishi: coordinate the rollback window, monitor infra metrics during the change, and prepare a rollback plan if we see unexpected behavior. (Owner: Rishi; ETA: Standby once pin is scheduled)

If we confirm these actions today, we can keep the pilot on schedule and avoid noisy metrics from an unintended model drift. Sofia — if you’re good, a reply like “OK to pin staging to rw-instruct-13b-v2” is enough and we’ll start.

Meeting to triage: I’ll schedule a 30-min slot for Tue 2027-03-16 10:30 PST and send a calendar invite; please flag if that conflicts.

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai

Attachments: trial_config_snapshot.json
